verdict.rationale: First-party tracing docs say the SDK has built-in tracing that records LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails and custom events during an agent run. A Traces dashboard lets developers debug, visualize and monitor those runs, which directly covers the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that every call is captured in the UI, and documented detail on span contents or export to third-party observability UIs.
